name: Sniper Varus

description:
### ✨ Overview

This mod turns Varus into Sniper from TF2.

#

### ✨ Additional information

The mod replaces the Base and T1 Varus skins.

#

### ✨ Features

* New model and textures
* New visual effects
* New voiceover 
* New sound effects
* New  loadingscreen and in-game icons
